plainSummary: The complete shared work loop now keeps CLI and MCP behavior aligned, enforces chosen methods and current evidence, and reports task activity and continuation limits without inventing authority or completion.
summary: Approved the complete W-008 implementation on the final frozen source across all three verticals. Shared operation breakers pass permission, stale-input, no-side-effect, immutable-review and cross-process receipt attacks; actual CLI/MCP lifecycle and packed executable tests pass 4/4. Custom-method breakers pass contract validation, skill and storage confinement, amendment freshness, ordered stages, scoped reviews, unresolved blockers and criterion-bound behavioral output gates; actual CLI/MCP method lifecycles pass. Execution breakers pass 12/12 for delayed and missing signals, retained waits, bounded files and summaries, concurrent accepted-write integrity with explicit loss uncertainty, exact registration lookup, sticky stops, hostile payload rejection, linked-worktree and symlink confinement, permission/expiry/retry blockers, unavailable host capabilities, concrete unsent guidance and emitter failure isolation. Actual CLI/MCP activity and persistent collector tests pass 3/3, UI execution copy tests pass 3/3, and the recorded final suite passes 209 tests with 23 explicit checks passing. Manual browser evidence confirms an MCP-started session, a live CLI waiting update, preserved disconnected observation, and verified acceptance progress remaining separate from completion blockers.

residualRisks: Portable permission, reviewer and host-session attribution remains agent reported; authenticated identity requires a trusted host boundary.
Activity delivery is bounded and best effort, so missing or rejected observations deliberately leave execution state uncertain.
This release has no verified host liveness, resume or cancellation adapter; those controls remain unavailable until a host supplies and verifies them.
